 Motorola Razr Ultra (2025) Finally Gets Android 17, and TikTok Came Along for the Ride
 Kristijan Lucic | Oct 23, 2026 
 Add Android Headlines as a preferred source on Google 
 Summary
 Motorola has begun rolling out Android 17 to the Razr Ultra (2025), with initial reports coming from users of unlocked AT&T models, although availability remains limited. The update reportedly installs TikTok and reactivates Moto AI for some users; the phone is expected to receive Android 18 as its final major OS upgrade, alongside security updates every two months through 2028.
 The Motorola Razr Ultra (2025) , the company’s flagship smartphone from last year, is now getting the Android 17 update . The Motorola Razr Ultra (2026) replaced this phone back in April, while the Motorola Razr Fold is also around, so the 2025 model is no longer a flagship.
 It is still an immensely powerful smartphone that just got more compelling thanks to this update. Motorola is a bit late in delivering this update, but the most important thing is that it’s finally here.
 Android 17 rollout starts for the Motorola Razr Ultra (2025)
 A user on Reddit reported that he’s getting the update, but what’s interesting is that other users are saying the same is not happening on their devices. It’s possible that the update is still limited, but the point is, it’s here, and that means that it’ll likely get a wider rollout soon.
 A user who is receiving the update said that TikTok was installed as part of the update. Moto AI, which he deactivated, was reactivated following this update. That’s not unusual, though; such updates tend to reactivate pre-installed apps.
 The phone that is receiving the update is an unlocked AT&T model, in case you were wondering.
 This update first started arriving to phones back in June
 Android 17 first started rolling out to phones back in June 2026, when Google’s Pixel devices started getting it. Back in August, Motorola promised that this update would land on 50 devices .
 Back in September, Motorola Razr, Edge, and Signature devices started getting the update. It’s now seemingly time for last year’s flagships to get the same treatment.
 As a reminder, the Motorola Razr Ultra (2025) is expected to get three major Android OS updates. This is not the last update it’ll get, as Android 18 will likely be the last one. It will also get bi-monthly security updates until 2028, based on what Motorola promised.
